BASS 20-250 Hz: ring-line wobble; stands in for beat and drums
MIDS 250-2000 Hz: flow speed and turbulence
HIGHS 2000-12000 Hz: colour saturation; stands in for percussion and synth
BEAT: flash of the whole picture, ring-line pulse, stroke-width pulse
DRUMS: stroke brightness
PERCUSSION: sparkle strokes
SYNTH: its hits start the travelling pulse of light
RISER: stroke width
